info.title: IntermodalTransportExecution
info.description:
This API enables Intermodal subcontractors who transport containers via truck, rail, and barge for Kuehne+Nagel to receive details about assigned consignments, including job details and instructions. It also allows them to provide status updates and proof of pickup/delivery on these consignments.
To use this API, subcontractors must be registered and set up as an API user  within our Intermodal TMS. Please discuss registration with your Kuehne+Nagel Intermodal operations point of contact.

get.description:
Retrieves assigned consignments for a subcontractor from a specific Kuehne+Nagel Intermodal department.

**Note:** A 204 No Content response (with no body) is returned when there are no new or updated consignments available. Refer to the API Guide in the Documents section for details.

type.description: A URI reference that uniquely identifies the problem type only in the context of the provided API. Opposed to the specification in RFC-7807, it is neither recommended to be dereferencable and point to a human-readable documentation nor globally unique for the problem type.

title.description: A short summary of the problem type. Written in English and readable for engineers, usually not suited for non technical stakeholders and not localized.\n

status.description: The HTTP status code generated by the origin server for this occurrence of the problem.\n

detail.description: A human readable explanation specific to this occurrence of the problem that is helpful to locate the problem and give advice on how to proceed. Written in English and readable for engineers, usually not suited for non technical stakeholders and not localized.\n

instance.description: A URI reference that identifies the specific occurrence of the problem, e.g. by adding a fragment identifier or sub-path to the problem type. May be used to locate the root of this problem in the source code.\n

assignedDateTime.description: The date and time when the consignment was assigned to the respective haulier in our system.

id.description: A unique identifier of the consignment.

haulageType.description: Specifies the type of haulage, can be either Container "CON" or General "GEN".

isProvisional.description: Indicates whether the consignment is provisional.

recipientUniqueShortName.description: Indicates the internal identifier of the recipient. This reference should be included in your request (Status/GPS) messages.

senderCompanyName.description: Specifies the trading name of Kuehne+Nagel's regional entity. This name must be used on invoices.

senderBranch.description: The branch of Kuehne+Nagel's entity assigning the consignment.

truckName.description: Name of the truck as define by Kuehne+Nagel Intermodal.

trailerLicensePlate.description: Trailer registration allocated to this consignment.

trailerSource.description: Whether the trailer is from "Pool" or "Private".

combineType.description: If multiple Jobs have been combined into the same Consignment, this defines that combination. The values allowed are, GEN = General, RLD = Reload or TWN = Twin.

Action.description: Specifies the action performed, one of INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE.

id.description: A unique identifier of the job. This reference should be included in your request (Status/GPS) messages.

uniqueTransportReference.description: A unique reference of Kuehne+Nagel's transport order. This reference should be included in your request (Status/GPS) messages.

purchaseOrderNumber.description: The reference of jobs purchase order. Usually used as reference on invoices updated via tradeshift.

jobType.description: Specifies type of job.The values allowed are IMP = Import, EXP = Export, REP = Reposition or DOM = Domestic.

trunkBranch.description: The specific branch of Kuehne+Nagel to which the job belongs.

movementMode.description: Indicates whether the container is full or empty. Allowed values are FUL = Full or EMP = Empty.

jobCategoryCode.description: Kuehne+Nagel country specific coded category of job.

vesselEtdEta.description: The vessel's Estimated Time of Arrival (ETA) for imports and Estimated Time of Departure (ETD) for exports.

hasVesselArrived.description: Vessel arrival to the port flag.

containerLandedDate.description: The date and time of container landed from vessel.

customsClearedDate.description: The date and time of customs clearance at the port.

containerAvailableDate.description: The date and time when the container is available for pickup.

demurrageStartDate.description: The date and time when demurrage starts.

detentionStartDate.description: The date and time when detention starts.

containerYardOpeningDate.description: Opening date/time of the Container Yard for this Job.

containerYardClosingDate.description: Closing date/time of the Container Yard for this Job.

driverInstructions.description: Specific instruction to driver related to job. May include the ePOD applications URL.
driverInstructions.example: Please wear safety shoes at the customer's warehouse. Ensure the reefer genset remains on at all times.

outOfGaugeComments.description: Any specific comments for oversized container.

containerTypeCode.description: Code of the container type. These Codes are Kuehne+Nagel specific hence please refer the documentation for equivalent ISO codes.

isBackEnd.description: Should container be loaded on the back end of the trailer (true/false). Used mostly for 20' container or Combine Type "TWN"

packageTypeDescription.description: Name of Package Type inside of the container.

transportMode.description: Indicates the required mode of transport for executing the job. Permissible values are ROA = Road, RAI = Rail, BAR = Barge, AIR = Air or SEA = Sea.

viaTerminal.description: The terminal used for transferring containers between different modes of transport, particularly in rail or barge movements.

lineBlNumber.description: The shipping line Bill of Lading number.

scacCode.description: The Standard Carrier Alpha Code (SCAC) of the shipping line.

isGgedRequired.description: Indicates whether GGED Certificate is required for Food shipments (true/false).

originCountryOfGoods.description: Country of origin of the goods.

name.description: Name of the operations contact person responsible for this job.

telephone.description: Telephone number of the operations contact person responsible for this job.

email.description: Email address of the operations contact person responsible for this job.

portOfLoading.description: Port of loading UN Location code.

portOfDischarge.description: Port of discharge UN Location code.

finalDestination.description: Port of Final Destination UN Location Code

itemNo.description: Item number of the customs data.

pieces.description: Number of pieces in the customs data.

description.description: Description of the cargo mentioned in customs data.

hsCode.description: Harmonized System Code (HS) of the cargo mentioned in customs data.

ata.description: ATA number of the cargo mentioned in customs data.

atb.description: ATB number of the cargo mentioned in customs data.

atc.description: ATC number of the cargo mentioned in customs data.

id.description: Unique identifier for the waypoint. This reference should be included in your status request messages.

activity.description: Indicates the type of waypoints. The values allowed are LOA = Load, C/D = Collect or Delivery, CUS = Customs, UNL = Unload or VGM = Verified Gross Mass.

date.description: Date of visit to the waypoint (YYYY-MM-DD).

time.description: Time of visit to the waypoint (HH:MM:SS).

reference.description: Any reference belong to the waypoint.

isOnOffHire.description: Indicates whether the container is on or off hire.

terminalCode.description: If Location is a Port, the Terminal Code is output.

depotCode.description: If Location is a Depot, the Depot Code is output.

unLocationCode.description: UN Location Code of the waypoint.

unNumber.description: UN Number of the hazardous material.

imoClass.description: IMO Class of the hazardous material.

adrHin.description: ADR Hazard Identification Number of the hazardous material.

adrNumber.description: ADR Number of the hazardous material.

eac.description: Emergency Action Code of the hazardous material.

packingGroup.description: Packing Group of the hazardous material.

tremcardNumber.description: Tremcard (Transport Emergency Card) Number of the hazardous material.

limitedQuantity.description: Indicates if the hazardous material is a limited quantity.

limitedQuantityMaximum.description: Maximum limited quantity of the hazardous material.

emergencyContact.description: Emergency contact for the hazardous material.

value.description: Flash point value of the hazardous material.

units.description: Unit of measurement for flash point.

marinePollutant.description: Indicates if the hazardous material is a marine pollutant.

outerPackagesQuantity.description: Number of outer packages of the hazardous material.

outerPackagesType.description: Type of outer packages of the hazardous material.

innerPackagesQuantity.description: Number of inner packages of the hazardous material.

innerPackagesType.description: Type of inner packages of the hazardous material.

chemicalName.description: Chemical name of the hazardous material.

ibcCode.description: IBC Code of the hazardous material.

value.description: Self-Accelerating Decomposition Temperature value of the hazardous material.
Gross weight of the hazardous material.

units.description: Unit of measurement for gross weight.

value.description: Net weight of the hazardous material.

units.description: Unit of measurement for net weight.

tunnelCode.description: Tunnel Code of the hazardous material.

nad.description: NAD number of the hazardous material.

ems.description: Emergency Response Procedures for Ships Carrying Dangerous Goods including the Emergency Schedules.

segregation.description: Segregation description of the hazardous material.

comments.description: Comments related to the hazardous material.

isExceptedQuantity.description: Indicates if the hazardous material is an excepted quantity.

neqVolume.description: Net Explosive Quantity Volume of the hazardous material.

subRisk1.description: Sub Risk 1 of the hazardous material.

subRisk2.description: Sub Risk 2 of the hazardous material.

subRisk3.description: Sub Risk 3 of the hazardous material.

handlingComments.description: Specific handling instructions related to the hazardous material.

chargeTypeCode.description: Charge Type Code of the rate.

chargeTypeDescription.description: Charge Type Description of the rate.

countryCode.description: ISO Country code of the address.

prev.description: the page before the current or requested page.

next.description: the page after the current or requested page. It'll be null if the last page from the provisioned page table from database.

hasMorePage.description: Indicates if there are more pages available in the result set.

senderUniqueShortName.description: Unique internal identifier of the message sender. This value can be found in consignment.recipientUniqueShortName from the AssignedConsignment response.

uniqueTransportReference.description: Unique reference of Kuehne+Nagel's transport order. This is the same as the consignment.job.uniqueTransportReference from the AssignedConsignment response.

consignmentAcceptanceStatus.description: Indicates if the assigned consignment will be accepted for execution or rejected.

truckLicensePlate.description: Truck license plate number allocated to this job.

trailerLicensePlate.description: Trailer registration allocated to this job.

id.description: Unique identifier of the assigned consignment job waypoint. This value can be found in consignment.job.waypoint.id from the AssignedConsignment response.

activity.description: Indicates the type of waypoint from the assigned consignment endpoint of the API. The values allowed are LOA = Load, C/D = Collect or Delivery, CUS = Customs, UNL = Unload, VGM = Verified Gross Mass.

unLocationCode.description: UN Location Code of the waypoint.

waypoint.description: When sending waypoint object, at least one of event or reference must be provided along with the required fields (id, activity, unLocationCode). The request will be ignored if neither event nor reference is part of request.

code.description: Indicates the event code for the waypoint status. PRO = Proposed, ETA = Estimated Arrival, ATA = Actual Arrival, ETD = Estimated Departure, ATD = Actual Departure.

dateTime.description: Date and time of the event, expressed in local time, formatted as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss[+/-HH:mm].

senderUniqueShortName.description: Unique internal identifier of the message sender. This must be same as consignment.recipientUniqueShortName from the AssignedConsignment response.

uniqueTransportReference.description: A unique reference of Kuehne+Nagel's transport order. This is the same as the consignment.job.uniqueTransportReference from the AssignedConsignment response.

gpsDateTime.description: Timestamp of the GPS data recording, expressed in local time, formatted as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss[+/-HH:mm].

longitude.description: Longitude coordinate of the transport unit's location.

latitude.description: Latitude coordinate of the transport unit's location.

locationAddress.description: Address of the corresponding GPS coordinates, if available.

speed.description: Speed at which the transport unit (truck, train, or barge) is moving at the specified location, measured in kilometers per hour, must be non-negative.

navigationHeading.description: Direction in which the transport unit is moving at the recorded location. Expressed in degrees from 0 to 360, with 0 representing true North, 90 true east, 180 true south, and 270 true west.

senderUniqueShortName.description: Unique internal identifier of the message sender. This must be same as consignment.recipientUniqueShortName from the AssignedConsignment response.

uniqueTransportReference.description: A unique reference of Kuehne+Nagel's transport order. This is the same as the consignment.job.uniqueTransportReference from the AssignedConsignment response.

isPodSignedOnGlass.description: Indicates whether the Proof of Delivery was signed digitally on a touchscreen device. Set this to false when submitting a scanned paper document without any associated metadata.

podSignedDateTime.description: Date and time when the Proof of Delivery was recorded, expressed in local time, formatted as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss[+/-HH:mm].

nameOfPersonSignedPod.description: Name of the person who signed the Proof of Delivery.

podSignatureImage.description: Image of the signature captured by the person receiving or releasing the shipment during the delivery or pickup. This must be shared in case of captured via a Signed on Glass (digital signature). Must have: a size of max. 2 MB and a supported file extension: png, jpeg/jpg, bmp.

podFile.description: Content of the proof of delivery document (preferably a PDF), provided when the POD is a physically scanned copy and not captured via a Signed on Glass (digital signature). Must have: a size of max. 5 MB and a supported file extension: pdf, png, jpeg/jpg.

podObservations.description: Any observations noted by receiver during delivery or pickup.
podObservations.example: Container genset was not ON during delivery.
